title: viola purpurea var. pinetorum
intro: Viola purpurea var. pinetorum, commonly known as the Purple Viola, is a flowering plant in the Violaceae family. It is a type of viola species known for its medicinal properties. The Purple Viola has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, such as colds, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola purpurea var. pinetorum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, that exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
